theorem interleaved_affine_gaps_imply_tensor_gaps
    (hC_proximityGapAffineLines : e_ε_correlatedAgreementAffineLinesNat
      (F := F) (A := A) (ι := ι) (C := MC) (e := e) (ε := ε))
    (h_interleaved_gaps : ∀ m : ℕ, m ≥ 1 →
      e_ε_correlatedAgreementAffineLinesNat (F := F)
        (A := InterleavedSymbol A (Fin m)) (ι := ι) (C := MC ^⋈ (Fin m)) e ε) :
    ∀ (ϑ : ℕ), (hϑ_gt_0 : ϑ > 0) → δ_ε_multilinearCorrelatedAgreement_Nat (F := F) (A := A)
      (ι := ι) (C := MC) (ϑ := ϑ) (e := e) (ε := ε) := by
    classical
    intro ϑ
    induction ϑ with
    | zero => intro u; contradiction
    | succ ϑ_sub_1 ih =>
      cases ϑ_sub_1 with
      | zero =>
        simp only [zero_add, zero_lt_one, forall_const]
        intro u hprob_gt
        let toAffineLineEval := multilinearCombine₁_eq_affineLineEvaluation (F := F) (u := u)
        simp_rw [toAffineLineEval, prob_uniform_singleton_finFun_eq (F := F)
          (P := fun r => Δ₀(affineLineEvaluation (u 0) (u 1) r, MC) ≤ e),
          Nat.cast_one, ENNReal.coe_one, one_mul] at hprob_gt
        have h_correlated_agreement := hC_proximityGapAffineLines (u 0) (u 1) hprob_gt
        simp only [jointProximityNat₂] at h_correlated_agreement
        have h_u_eq : u = finMapTwoWords (u 0) (u 1) := by
          funext rowIdx
          fin_cases rowIdx <;> rfl
        rw [h_u_eq.symm] at h_correlated_agreement
        exact h_correlated_agreement
      | succ ϑ_sub_2 =>
        intro hϑ_gt_0 u hP_multilinearCombine_close_gt
        set ϑ_pred := ϑ_sub_2 + 1
        set U₀ : Fin (2 ^ ϑ_pred) → Word A ι := (splitHalfRowWiseInterleavedWords (ϑ := ϑ_pred) u).1
        set U₁ : Fin (2 ^ ϑ_pred) → Word A ι := (splitHalfRowWiseInterleavedWords (ϑ := ϑ_pred) u).2
        unfold jointProximityNat; simp only
        have h_finsnoc_eq_r : ∀ r : Fin (ϑ_pred + 1) → F,
          Fin.snoc (fun i ↦ r i.castSucc) (r (Fin.last ϑ_pred)) = r := fun r => by
          funext i
          by_cases h : i = Fin.last ϑ_pred
          · simp only [h, Fin.snoc_last]
          · have h_i_lt : i.val < ϑ_pred + 1 := i.isLt
            have h_i_ne_last : i.val ≠ ϑ_pred := by
              intro h_eq
              apply h
              exact Fin.ext (by simp [h_eq])
            have h_lt : i.val < ϑ_pred := by omega
            simp only [Fin.snoc, Fin.castSucc_castLT h_lt, cast_eq, dite_eq_ite, ite_eq_left_iff]
            <;> simp_all [Fin.ext_iff]
        let P : F → (Fin ϑ_pred → F) → Prop := fun r_last r_init =>
          Δ₀(multilinearCombine (u := u) (r := Fin.snoc r_init r_last), MC) ≤ e
        have hP_split_r_last := prob_split_last_uniform_sampling_of_finFun (ϑ := ϑ_pred) (F := F) (P := P)
        simp_rw [h_finsnoc_eq_r, multilinearCombine_recursive_form, Fin.snoc_last, Fin.init_snoc] at hP_split_r_last
        rw [hP_split_r_last] at hP_multilinearCombine_close_gt
        have h_prob_Rstar_gt_eps_div_q : Pr_{ let r ← $ᵖ F }[ r ∈ R_star_tensor MC (m := ϑ_pred) (e := e) (ε := ε) U₀ U₁ ]
          > (↑ε : ENNReal) / (Fintype.card F : ENNReal) := by
          exact prob_R_star_gt_threshold (MC := MC) (ε := ε) (ϑ := ϑ_pred) (u := u) (e := e) hP_multilinearCombine_close_gt
        have h_line_close_to_C_m : ∀ (r : R_star_tensor MC (m := ϑ_pred) (e := e) (ε := ε) U₀ U₁),
          jointProximityNat (u := affineLineEvaluation U₀ U₁ r.val) (e := e) (C := MC) := by
          intro r_in_Rstar
          apply correlatedAgreement_of_mem_R_star_tensor (ih := fun u_prev => ih (by omega) u_prev) (u := u)
        have h_C_m_gap := h_interleaved_gaps (2 ^ ϑ_pred) Nat.one_le_two_pow
        have h_prob_line_gt_eps_div_q :
          Pr_{ let r ← $ᵖ F }[ Δ₀(affineLineEvaluation (u₀ := ⋈|(show WordStack A (Fin (2 ^ ϑ_pred)) ι from U₀)) (u₁ := ⋈|(show WordStack A (Fin (2 ^ ϑ_pred)) ι from U₁)) (r := r),
            ((MC ^⋈ (Fin (2 ^ ϑ_pred))))) ≤ e ] > (↑ε : ENNReal) / (Fintype.card F : ENNReal) := by
          apply lt_of_le_of_lt' _ h_prob_Rstar_gt_eps_div_q
          apply Pr_le_Pr_of_implies (D := $ᵖ F)
            (g := fun r => Δ₀(affineLineEvaluation (u₀ := ⋈|(show WordStack A (Fin (2 ^ ϑ_pred)) ι from U₀)) (u₁ := ⋈|(show WordStack A (Fin (2 ^ ϑ_pred)) ι from U₁)) (r := r),
              ((MC ^⋈ (Fin (2 ^ ϑ_pred))))) ≤ e)
            (f := fun r => r ∈ R_star_tensor MC (m := ϑ_pred) (e := e) (ε := ε) U₀ U₁)
          intro r hr_in_Rstar
          specialize h_line_close_to_C_m ⟨r, hr_in_Rstar⟩
          unfold jointProximityNat at h_line_close_to_C_m; assumption
        have h_final_gap : jointProximityNat₂ (u₀ := ⋈|(show WordStack A (Fin (2 ^ ϑ_pred)) ι from U₀)) (u₁ := ⋈|(show WordStack A (Fin (2 ^ ϑ_pred)) ι from U₁)) (e := e)
          (C := (MC ^⋈ (Fin (2 ^ ϑ_pred)))) := by
          apply h_C_m_gap (u₀ := ⋈|(show WordStack A (Fin (2 ^ ϑ_pred)) ι from U₀)) (u₁ := ⋈|(show WordStack A (Fin (2 ^ ϑ_pred)) ι from U₁)) h_prob_line_gt_eps_div_q
        apply CA_split_rowwise_implies_CA (u := u) (e := e)
        exact h_final_gap
